subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
syllabus_extract: Qualitative displays: - Director displays. Head- up displays.
specific_objectives: 15.1.2.2 Trainee will be able to explain Qualitative displays of typical instrument.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of qualitative instrument diagrams; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a qualitative display?
Name one example of a qualitative display found in aircraft.
How does a qualitative display differ from a quantitative display?

development.content:
Definition of qualitative displays
Characteristics of director displays
Components of director displays
Operational limitations of director displays

Working principle of director displays
Interpretation of directional cues
Integration with flight instruments
Safety considerations for director displays

Comparison with head-up displays
Advantages of director displays
Disadvantages of director displays
Future trends in display technology

summary_questions: Explain the main difference between a director display and a quantitative display.
Describe how a pilot interprets directional cues from a director display.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the role of qualitative displays in the next lesson plan (LP 07) regarding identification of qualitative instrument displays.
